resources.string: This application demonstrates alternative responsive layouts in Android. The default portrait layout uses a vertical LinearLayout (from Practical 1). When the device is rotated to landscape, a two-pane LinearLayout is loaded automatically. On devices whose smallest screen dimension is at least 600dp (e.g. 7-inch tablets), a two-pane ConstraintLayout is loaded instead. No Java code changes are required - the resource system picks the right layout for the current configuration.
Part 1: Orientation Qualifier (layout-land)\nPart 2: Smallest Width Qualifier (layout-sw600dp)\nStudent: Guo Yuqi (20243006972)
